There’s one word that comes to my mind talking about this clinic and Dr. Robert Yeghiyan and is GRATITUDE. Over the last few years Marta my French bulldog and her multiples issues are in and out of the clinic. Dr. Robert Yeghiyan Always finds the time to see her when some issue comes up. Fully dedicated to his job , the love for the animals
, the time that he takes explaining all the details about the illness and the treatment to follow , an email after the visit with all the information. This kind of dedication is hard to find. From  Dr. Robert Yeghiyan to all the reception and staff I only have gratitude for their professionalism and dedication , and patience for my impatience behaviour . Thank you very much for your hard work .
Veterinary clinic, I highly recommend it for my girls Madona and Luna 💯 …
This clinic is simply wonderful. Dr. Robert is incredible, very capable and experienced.
